scope: Production ExploreWalk, 600 actual physics ticks at requested30Hz (20 simulated seconds) and per-body movement/support/contact/source-station checks for30 pedestrian bodies and14 cars. Maximum step is the unchanged metre-per-second limit divided by requestedHz plus the existing.006m tolerance. Four5-second dense-floor/containment observations remain unchanged in simulated time. Explicit later crossing fixture and player observer starts only. Native PNGs require separate visual review. Poll timing is instrumentation cost, not FPS/performance acceptance, surveyed elevation, M4 or human-handling validation.
